primary_text: "What are the actual total costs? Stamp duty, council rates, body corp — it adds up fast." Horror stories about hidden costs stop too many business owners from buying. But the costs aren't actually hidden — they're just rarely explained properly. With our Truganina warehouses, you get a full cost schedule before you commit: stamp duty, body corporate, council rates, legals, and everything else. No surprises at settlement. 20km from Melbourne CBD. Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access. Limited units available. Know the real numbers now.
